_about: Field-interaction fragment (List 19 #181) — annex to #47's mochiichao/battle-field/v1. It founds no new field format: terrain conditions are #47 records with slot TERRAIN. The interaction table ships EMPTY (zero pair rows) because every modifier value in #47 is OPEN; the reader default (independent) keeps the empty table fully defined. Resolution order inside #17's [field] stage is fixed here and cited by #47/#17 at landing.

clearPaths: expiry — duration_turns counts down in END_CHECK (#47 tick placement); the running instance carries its own turns_left, immune to later record edits
overwrite — a new terrain replaces the old, always (#47)
clear_triggers — the record's named moves/conditions (#47 field)
battle end — terrain is battle state; never persisted, never stored
model.defaultResolution: independent — a default of the READER when no pair row exists, not a row in the table
model.duration: the #47 record's duration_turns (integer | until_cleared | OPEN); all values OPEN
model.pairRow: a row with resolution 'pair' names a combined-modifier record in #47's registry format; it replaces the weather+terrain pair of terms at their position in the order
model.resolutionOrder: inside #17's [field] stage: weather term, then terrain term, then room term; a pair row replaces the weather+terrain terms at that position
setPaths: move — move data names a terrain condition id in #47's set_by; the #9 animscript performs it
ability — a #107 hook naming a condition id (entry / weather-react classes; resolution per #184)
field-start — encounter/area data seats a terrain at battle start
model.statusJoin: status_block / status_grant ride each condition's own #47 fields independently; pair rows speak to status only via a pair-row record's own #47 fields
model.worldSource: none — world state seeds the WEATHER slot only (#61/#19 via #47); terrain is battle-scoped. Depths: weather seeds NONE -> null (#61); move-set terrain there is ordinary mechanics, no exception asserted

open_register: the entire terrain roster (ids, display names — owner canon/balance pass, reserved by #47)
every terrain's duration_turns and modifier values (#47's OPEN state, unchanged)
every interaction pair row (the table ships empty)
which moves/abilities seat terrain (move data / #107 contents, both uninstanced)
